description: This file declares the IpcClient class and IpcClientAccessor class, which are part of the Rialto client IPC mechanism. It defines interfaces for creating and managing IPC channels, controllers, and closures, and includes methods for connecting and disconnecting IPC communication.

classes.name: IpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to an IIpcClient instance, implementing the IIpcClientAccessor interface.

classes.name: IpcClient
classes.description: Implements the IIpcClient interface, managing IPC channels, controllers, and closures, and handling connection lifecycle.

methods.name: IpcClientAccessor::getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the associated IIpcClient instance.

methods.name: IpcClient::IpcClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IpcClient with factories for IPC channel, controller, and closure.

methods.name: IpcClient::~IpcClient
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the IpcClient instance.

methods.name: IpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the current IPC channel.

methods.name: IpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a new blocking closure for IPC communication.

methods.name: IpcClient::createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller.

methods.name: IpcClient::processIpcThread
methods.description: Handles the IPC thread's processing loop.

methods.name: IpcClient::connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection between the Rialto server and client.

methods.name: IpcClient::disconnect
methods.description: Closes the IPC connection between the Rialto server and client.
